_comment: AEGIS-Cloud — Cloud / Functions / Threat Evaluator / Function Config
PURPOSE: Azure Function trigger and binding configuration for the
Threat Evaluator agent.  This function is triggered by IoT Hub
telemetry events routed through Azure Event Grid.
DESIGN: The Event Grid trigger receives detection events and enriched
telemetry from the Edge layer.  The function output binding writes
the ThreatAssessment result to Cosmos DB for Power BI consumption
